extName.message: Multilingual CC for Twitch via OBS

extDescription.message: Transcribe speech in a selected language, translate it in Chrome, and send it to Twitch as OBS closed captions.

err_fatalServiceNotAllowed.message: Speech recognition service isn't allowed. Check settings, then restart.

err_fatalLanguageNotSupported.message: The selected recognition language isn't supported by speech recognition.

err_micBlocked.message: Microphone is blocked. Change this extension to "Allow" at chrome://settings/content/microphone, then press "Refresh & allow" again.

err_micHelperOpenFailed.message: Couldn't open the microphone permission tab. Press "Refresh & allow" again.

err_translatorPairUnavailable.message: The Chrome Translator API doesn't support $SOURCE$→$TARGET$

err_replacementsInvalidJson.message: Specify term replacements as a JSON object

ui_micPermissionHint.message: If microphone permission isn't granted yet, "Refresh & allow" opens a tab to grant it. Choose "Allow" in the dialog that appears.

ui_languageHint.message: Choose "Other (type manually)" to enter a language code that isn't in the list.

pair_incomplete.message: Enter a language to check availability.

pair_downloadable.message: This language pair needs a one-time model download when you start.

pair_unavailable.message: ✗ This language pair isn't supported by the Chrome Translator API.

pair_sameLanguage.message: Recognition and target languages are the same.

pair_unknown.message: Availability unknown in this Chrome version.

ui_obsPasswordPersistLabel.message: Save password on this device (skip re-entry after Chrome restarts)

ui_obsPasswordWarning.message: Enabling this stores the password unencrypted on this PC. Anyone with access to this PC's Chrome profile could then fully control OBS (stop the stream, switch scenes, etc.). Don't enable this on a shared PC. By default (disabled) it's cleared when Chrome restarts.

ui_obsMicInputHint.message: When set, captions won't be sent while this input is muted in OBS.

ui_segmentIntervalHint.message: Sending back to back overwrites the previous caption before it can be read (provisional value).

ui_interimFlushHint.message: Splits a long utterance into chunks of this many characters before it's finalized, and sends each chunk to translation early. Faster to display, but since it splits mid-sentence, the translation near a split can occasionally look unnatural or duplicated (provisional value).

ui_privacyNote.message: Chrome's regular speech recognition may send audio to a recognition service. Translation uses Chrome's built-in Translator API, and caption text isn't stored by default.

log_interimFlushed.message: Flushed a long in-progress utterance for translation ($CHARS$ chars)

log_translatedCaptionDropped.message: Dropped a translated caption without sending: $REASON$

log_micPermissionInProgress.message: Microphone permission is in progress. Please wait.

log_micHelperOpened.message: Opened the microphone permission tab. Choose "Allow" in the dialog that appears.

log_micHelperClosed.message: The microphone permission tab was closed. Permission wasn't granted.

log_micPermissionIncomplete.message: Microphone permission wasn't completed. Press "Refresh & allow" again, or "Request permission again" in the permission tab.

log_obsPasswordSaved.message: Saved the OBS password on this device

log_obsPasswordRemoved.message: Removed the saved OBS password from this device

micHelper_requesting.message: Requesting microphone permission. Choose "Allow" in the dialog that appears.

micHelper_autoCloseNote.message: This tab closes automatically once permission is granted. If it doesn't, close it manually.

micHelper_granted.message: Microphone granted. This tab will close automatically.

micHelper_errNotAllowed.message: Microphone is blocked. Change this extension to "Allow" at chrome://settings/content/microphone, then try again below.

micHelper_errNotFound.message: No usable microphone was found. Connect a microphone, then try again below.

micHelper_errMediaUnavailable.message: This browser doesn't support microphone access.

micHelper_errGeneric.message: Couldn't grant the microphone ($ERRORNAME$). Try again below.
